item.text: I’m consolidating the report structure now that the remaining code paths have been checked; this is a readability/handoff improvement rather than another speculative finding.

The report is now consolidated with a summary of the 22 reproduced findings and their risk groups: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation reviewed the remaining session/expiry and observer-master paths. `SessionTrackerTest` and `ExpiryQueueTest` passed, and no new concrete defect was found in those paths. The report remains at 22 findings, covering:

- snapshot and recovery state
- transaction-log truncation, duplicates, and empty-tail zxid reporting
- epoch initialization
- oracle election, revalidation, and missing-oracle safety
- follower/observer duplicate, gap, and null-packet handling
- malformed multi-op and unknown transaction types
- reconfiguration leader selection
- snapshot-size configuration

All reproduction files and observed outputs remain under `repro/`; the captured source was not modified.
